text.p: Tropical Storm Marco drifts eastward in the western Caribbean about 340 miles south-southwest of Kingston Jamaica. This system will become an increasing risk to shipping as winds approach 70 mph by 24-48 hours. Marco is expected to track across Jamaica and far eastern Cuba late this period. Heavy rains could lead to flooding in these areas during that time and also across Hispanola. Winds would be some problem near and just east of the storm track but the strongest risk is from flooding rains.

A strong storm system moves eastward across Benelux, northwest Germany and Denmark during Wednesday. Strong winds will impact shipping in the Bay of Biscay, the English Channel and the southern North Sea during this period. Coastal beach errosion is also expected for northwest France and the southern British Isles as strong northwest winds pound the coast.
